text:
Predicates:
HeckCattle(x) ::: x are Heck cattle.
Aurochs(x) ::: x are aurochs.
Animals(x) ::: x are animals.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resemble y.
Extinct(x) ::: x are extinct.
Premises:
∀x (HeckCattle(x) → Animals(x)) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back in the 1920s to resemble the aurochs.
∀x (HeckCattle(x) → Animals(x)) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
∀x (Aurochs(x) → Animals(x)) ::: Aurochs are animals.
∃x ∃y (Animals(x) ∧ Resemble(x, y) ∧ Extinct(y)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.
Conclusion:
Extinct(aurochs) ::: Aurochs are extinct.
